The time from asking for a sandbox to having one that will execute code. A V8 context is a fresh global inside a V8 isolate that is already running: it is cheap because it shares that isolate’s heap. Timings are the median of the pass.
an M-series laptop · the pass of 2026-09-07 · median of the pass
A context runs JavaScript, which makes it the right primitive for a JavaScript transform. An agent that installs a package or runs a shell gets a microVM instead, which is a separate measurement.
What this measures, and what it does not
This is the time to the first instruction, on an idle machine. It says nothing about what happens when a thousand sandboxes are asked for at once.
A single pass on one laptop, reproducible by one command. Read it as a floor that has been established rather than as a service level.
A sandbox is what an agent needs to run a command. What it costs to keep an agent that is doing nothing is
, and what a running agent holds is
. The three are separate measurements with separate commands and they do not add up into a single number.
It is one of three costs, not the cost.
